content: Hi! How can I help you with the event photos or videos today?
Hello! I wanted to see if the group album from the celebration is ready to view yet.
Absolutely! The album is live, just click the shared link to browse through everyone's best moments. I made sure it's set to view-only, so everyone's privacy is protected.
That's great. Can I download a few of the original files for our newsletter?
Of course! Feel free to download any originals you need, just tap the download icon under each photo. Let me know if you need a ZIP of the whole set.
Thanks! I noticed a few group shots from the dinner are missing. Should I upload mine?

That would be wonderful! Please upload your photos to the 'Dinner Highlights' folder in the album. If anyone else is in the photos, double-check that they're comfortable with sharing, thanks for keeping consent in mind.
Will do. Is there an easy way to organize everything by activity?
Great question. Each folder is labeled by activity, just drag your uploads into the right one. Browsing by folder makes finding memories much simpler for everyone.
I love how organized this is! Is the highlight video available too?
Yes! The highlight video is in the 'Recap Videos' folder, click to watch or download your own copy. I hope it brings back all the best moments!
Downloading it now. Thanks so much for coordinating all of this.
My pleasure, it's wonderful seeing everyone's memories come together. If you spot any photos that need edits or want to add captions, just let me know!
